stories.title: ‘Let’s keep us alive’: Nova Scotia clothing brand struggles amid U.S. trade dispute
stories.summary: A Halifax-area clothing brand is feeling the impact of the ongoing trade war between Canada and the United States and is being forced to make changes to how it does business.

stories.title: Nova Scotia selects this year’s Christmas tree to say ‘thank you’ to Boston
stories.summary: Nova Scotia sends the U.S. city a large Christmas tree every year to thank it for sending medical personnel and supplies after the Halifax Explosion in 1917.

stories.title: Halifax councillors question how infrastructure will be funded after extended fee freeze
stories.summary: Nova Scotia has extended its freeze on increasing development fees in Halifax and some councillors say they're concerned about where to find money for infrastructure upgrades.

stories.title: NDP renews call for emergency debate on $10B Cape Breton AI data centre project
stories.summary: The Official Opposition in Nova Scotia is renewing its call for emergency debate in the legislature following last month's announcement of a $10-billion AI data centre project.

stories.title: Nova Scotia seafood sector welcomes China deal extension, but some exporters feel left out
stories.summary: Many in the industry were worried China would soon reinstate a 25-per-cent tariff targeting lobster, Nova Scotia's main seafood export.

stories.title: Bedford residents raise concerns about density, traffic at waterfront project open house
stories.summary: The revitalization project includes a high-speed ferry service linking Bedford to downtown Halifax that's expected to begin in 2030.

stories.title: Amazon breaks ground on 200,000-square metre fulfilment warehouse in the Halifax area
stories.summary: The online retailer says the warehouse in Dartmouth, N.S., will cover more than 200,000-square metres in the Burnside industrial park.

stories.title: Second night for community questions on Nova Scotia’s first proposed AI data centre
stories.summary: Cape Bretoners with questions about Nova Scotia's first planned artificial intelligence data centre have a second chance to speak up.

stories.title: Judge orders Bitcoin, laptop be returned to convicted killer William Sandeson
stories.summary: A judge has ordered a laptop containing William Sandeson’s Bitcoin returned to his family, with its disputed value ranging from $8,000 to over $200,000.

stories.title: AI data centre proponent in Nova Scotia makes its pitch to Cape Breton communities
stories.summary: The proponent of a major artificial intelligence data centre proposal in southern Cape Breton is slated to make its pitch to local residents in person.
